name: Pixel Art Web
summary: Blocky sprites, a limited palette, hard pixel edges, bitmap type and game-style panels. It borrows from 8-bit and 16-bit games and makes a page feel like a game screen.

philosophy.core_thesis: Limits are the style: few pixels, few colours and a hard grid make a clear, playful picture.
design_principles: Draw art on a base grid of 8px or 16px sprites and scale only by whole numbers (2x, 3x, 4x).
Limit the palette to 8 to 16 colours; use 1 outline colour and no more than 3 tones per material.
Render images with `image-rendering: pixelated` and never use anti-aliased scaling.
Build panels with a 4px stepped border (corner pixels cut) and a 4px hard shadow offset (4px, 4px) with no blur.
Set text in a bitmap face at multiples of 8px (8, 16, 24, 32px) with a line height of 1.5.
Animate in steps: use `steps(4)` for sprites at 8 to 12 frames per second and blink cursors at 1s.
Show a game element on each screen: a health bar, a counter, a menu with a pointer or a dialogue box.
anti_patterns: Rounded corners with a smooth radius

layout.grid_mechanics: A pixel grid of 8px; panels snap to it; the screen is a stage with a HUD frame and a dialogue box at the bottom.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the surface is empty; spacing is 8, 16, 24 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: Left-aligned text in boxes; menus in a vertical list with a pointer; counters in the corners.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with stepped corners (a 4px notch); 4px borders; hard 4px offset shadows.

font_pairings.note: An 8-bit display face on an 8px grid.
A compact pixel face for labels.
A pixel sans that stays readable in longer text.

typography.tracking: Tracking stays at 0 so the pixels line up.
hierarchy_rules: Use one weight (400) and let size and colour make hierarchy.
Set body at 16px in the readable pixel sans.

color.contrast_rules: Bone on night holds 14:1; slate on night holds at least 7:1; lava marks action and mint marks success.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour with dithering (checks of 1px or 2px) instead of gradients.
color.light_and_shadow: Hard: a 4px offset shadow in a darker tone; no blur.

materiality.surface_simulation: Pixels on a screen: flat, hard and countable.
materiality.border_rules: A 4px border with stepped corners in the outline colour.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Hard offset shadow (4px, 4px) in a darker tone; no blur; no radius.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Pixel icons on a 16px or 24px grid, solid with a 1px outline; hearts, coins and arrows.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Sprites, tile maps, dithered skies and pixel characters.

motion.transition_physics: Frame-based: sprites animate at 8 to 12 frames per second; menus move one step at a time; text types out at 20 characters per second.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover moves a pointer sprite beside the item and inverts the colours; active state shifts the box 4px down and right.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels play, nostalgia and the joy of a small, clear world.

avoid_when: The brand needs a premium, calm look.
The page has long reading text.
The audience is not familiar with games.

modifiers.how: Use flat fills, a 4px radius and a plain sans; keep the palette.
Use pink and violet gradients and a perspective grid under the sprites.
Remove sprites and keep text and a mono grid.

pack.why: A pixel family drawn on a strict 24px grid that fits bitmap type.

ground.why: Pixel art draws a night sky of single pixels over stepped hills on a coarse grid.
